Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production full-body transparent character illustration for BroBattler, a dark medieval fantasy mobile autobattler. Primary request: wholly redesign BATTLE ALCHEMIST as a distinctive asymmetrical fantasy support fighter, NOT another brown plate-armored male knight. A wiry older woman field chemist, sharp weathered face, wild swept-back grey hair tied with a practical teal headwrap, round protective goggles pushed above her eyes. Crooked forward-working stance, broad waxed ochre leather apron over deep teal rolled-sleeve clothing, chunky practical boots. Main unmistakable prop: a LARGE round acid flask held out in a gloved hand, chartreuse fluid visible within glass; other hand steadies its brass stopper/tongs. Compact copper distillation backpack with TWO short curved glass tubes and one squat reservoir, restrained equipment, not an enormous sci-fi machine. Clear triangular hunched silhouette, visible gap between legs and arms, believable anatomy and gear.
Rendering: richly textured painterly realistic dark-fantasy collectible-game art, controlled edges and simplified large masses, excellent readability at 100px. Warm ochre, teal cloth, copper, single acid-green accent; NO full plate, NO generic sword, NO staff, NO skull mask.
Composition: one character only, near frontal three-quarter view, entire figure and all equipment visible, centered, portrait canvas about 2:3. Both soles clearly visible at a shared implied ground plane, stable standing stance, feet near bottom with a little safe padding. The character occupies 88% of canvas height; no cut-off hands/feet/props. Uniform soft upper-left lighting and subtle highlights to read on a dark forest battlefield.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no colored backdrop, no floor, no scenery, no circular plinth, no text, no labels, no frame, no watermark. No shadow extending below feet, no glow haze around silhouette, no floating pose. This is one static key illustration, NOT an animation sheet.
units.finalBackgroundEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact alchemist illustration to keep. Change ONLY the grey-and-white checkerboard background into one completely flat saturated MAGENTA (#FF00FF) chroma-key color. Replace the checkerboard everywhere outside the character, between arms/legs and through empty spaces in gear. Preserve the woman alchemist, face, anatomy, hair, equipment, acid bottle, palette, pose and all painting details. No relighting, no magenta reflections, no magenta spill on the character, no added scenery or shadows. Do not attempt transparency and do not draw a checkerboard. Keep same full-body framing, 1024x1536 portrait, no text.
